description: Convolution processor: the input is convolved with an impulse response, a recording of a space or of any other sound, loaded from a WAV file of as much as 60 seconds or recorded on the spot

params.text: How much of the convolved audio is fed back in to be pre-delayed and convolved again. Past a point the loop runs away, so raise it a little at a time; the output is soft-clipped
Cutoff of the high-pass filter applied before the signal is convolved
Cutoff of the low-pass filter applied before the signal is convolved
Gain on the signal going into the convolution. Impulse responses are levelled by their root-mean-square as they load, and this trims the result
How long the dry signal is delayed before it is convolved
Stereo spread of the convolved signal; at 0% it is mono, and it is then mixed with a dry signal that may be stereo
Balance between the dry input and the convolved signal
How far the voltage at the GAIN input moves the input gain, and in which direction
How far the voltage at the FDBK input moves the feedback, and in which direction
How far the voltage at the HP input moves the high-pass cutoff, and in which direction
How far the voltage at the LP input moves the low-pass cutoff, and in which direction
How far the voltage at the WIDTH input moves the stereo spread, and in which direction
How far the voltage at the MIX input moves the dry and wet balance, and in which direction
Hold to record an impulse response from the audio inputs; the moment recording stops that recording is loaded and convolution carries on with it

inputs.text: CV over the dry and wet balance
Audio in; with no cable in RIGHT this signal feeds both channels
Right channel of the audio in
Recording of an impulse response runs for as long as the gate here is high; when it falls the recording is loaded and used

outputs.text: Left channel out, the dry and processed signals mixed
Right channel out, the dry and processed signals mixed

notes: Nothing reaches the wet path until an impulse response is loaded: click the display, use Load IR on the right-click menu, or hold the record button to capture one from the audio inputs
menu: Load IR — picks the WAV file to convolve with; clicking the display does the same, and 26 impulse responses are shipped with the plugin
Reverse IR — plays the loaded impulse response backwards
Stretch — changes the length of the loaded impulse response and its pitch together
Save IR as — writes the loaded impulse response out to a WAV file
